steps.query: SELECT id, relationship, status FROM stu.guardianships WHERE tenant_id = 'a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001' AND deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1

steps.title: Schema Ownership / RLS Audit
steps.description: Verify guardianships RLS is enabled and FORCED
steps.query: SELECT c.relname FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = 'stu' AND c.relname = 'guardianships' AND c.relrowsecurity = true AND c.relforcerowsecurity = true
